copy.tagline_en: Create performant and accessible web animations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need smooth and accessible animations for your website.

howto.what: Claude会根据本指南生成符合GPU加速、减少运动、合适计时函数和持续时间的CSS动画代码，并避免常见错误（如动画布局属性、无限循环等）。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或优化Web动画（如悬停效果、入场动画、页面过渡等），或询问动画性能最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个鼠标悬停时放大的按钮动画
say.note: 返回使用transform: scale和过渡的CSS代码

say.text: 给列表添加淡入滑动动画，使用AutoAnimate
为页面切换添加平滑过渡动画，持续时间300ms

howto.what_en: Claude generates CSS animation code following GPU-accelerated properties, reduced motion, appropriate timing functions and durations, avoiding common mistakes like animating layout properties or infinite loops.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user requests creating or optimizing web animations (e.g., hover effects, entrance animations, page transitions) or asks about animation performance best practices.

say_en.text: Write a button animation that scales up on hover
say_en.note: Returns CSS code using transform: scale and transition

say_en.text: Add fade-in slide animation to a list using AutoAnimate
say_en.note: Returns React code using the AutoAnimate library

say_en.text: Create a smooth page transition animation lasting 300ms
